title: backlog.py begin ID... starts the next ready items in one call: overlap check, claim, claim push and detached dispatch
goal: begin ID... --by NAME --dry-run prints one line per item, the claim and dispatch it would make or the refusal, and writes nothing; an item whose touches overlap an earlier item of the batch or a held claim is refused with the overlap named and the others are still planned, with exit 1 when any item was refused; without --dry-run begin claims each accepted item with --commit and the --trailer given, sends the claim commits once through land_push and dispatches each with --detach, printing its id, pid and log path; the sprint skill's run steps 2 and 3 name begin
